description: This header file defines utility functions within the Utils namespace for synchronizing file state and persisting JSON settings to disk in a C++ project.

methods.name: void syncPersistFile(const string file)
methods.description: Synchronizes a file on disk to ensure all buffered data is written, based on the provided filename.

methods.name: void persistJsonSettings(const string strFile,const string strKey,const JsonValue & jsValue)
methods.description: Persists JSON settings to a specified file, updating a key with a JSON value, and then synchronizes the file to disk.
